# Single sign-on

## Summary

AcmeLake supports single sign-on through SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect identity providers. Local
username and password accounts are also available for administrators. Groups from the identity
provider can be mapped to AcmeLake roles.

## Details

- SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect.
- Group to role mapping.
